Key-value

Facts about one thing as label and value pairs: stacked on a phone, in two columns at 768px and wider.

Status: draft

Examples

When to use it

  • For the facts of one run, task, repository or request: its branch, its path, when it started, what it cost.
  • Inside a card or a disclosure, or straight on the page under a heading.
  • With mono values for anything the reader may copy or compare character by character: a path, a commit hash, a command, a branch name.

When not to use it

  • For the same facts about several things. Use the data table, where each thing is a row.
  • For one number that deserves emphasis, with its comparison. Use the stat.
  • For values the reader edits. Use fields.
  • For a value the reader copies with one press. Use the copy field.
  • For a status that needs a tone. Write the status in words as the value, or put one badge in it.

Variants

default
Values in the interface typeface.
mono value ds-key-value__value--mono
On a single value, with ds-key-value__value: a path, a hash, a command or a branch name, in the mono typeface. Mix it freely with plain values in one list.
empty value ds-key-value__value--empty
On a value that is not there, with ds-key-value__value. The value is written in words, such as Not set, and drawn in the quiet colour.

Accessibility

  • Use a dl. Each pair is a div with the class ds-key-value__item, holding one dt, ds-key-value__label, and one dd, ds-key-value__value. A screen reader then announces each value with its label.
  • The label is a noun in sentence case with no colon. The stylesheet does not add one.
  • A value is never blank and never a lone dash. When there is none, write it in words: Not set, None opened yet. The quiet colour of the empty variant supports the words and does not replace them.
  • A number carries its unit, and a time is written so it cannot be misread, inside a time element with a datetime attribute.
  • A long value wraps inside its column, breaking at any character when it must, so the page never scrolls sideways. Do not truncate a path or a hash.
  • The component has no controls and needs no script. While the facts load, show a spinner in place of the list; if they cannot be read, an error state.
